steps.name: exercise create_for_issue on a throwaway clone
steps.run: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; TMP=$(mktemp -d); git -C "$TMP" init --initial-branch=main -q && git -C "$TMP" commit --allow-empty -m seed -q; mix run -e "{:ok, path} = SymphonyElixir.Workspace.create_for_issue(%{number: 4242}, clone_path: \"$TMP\"); IO.puts(path)" > /tmp/wsout; WORKSPACE=$(tail -n1 /tmp/wsout); BRANCH=$(git -C "$WORKSPACE" branch --show-current); test "$BRANCH" = "opal/4242"'
